_comment: shared by go / ts / py. The fixture opts into telemetry, so `total` is
13 and factor 13 must be `pass` in every port. A port that omits F13
entirely, or skips it despite enabled:true, diverges on `total` and on
the `factors` map — which is exactly what this harness exists to catch.
Only the static pass is observed (empty binary path), so the
runtime-only factors 3, 9 and 10 are `skip` and factor 12 is `skip`
because the fixture declares no auth_commands. Those skips still count
toward the denominator; only an F13 skip on a non-opt-in spec is
excluded, which is why the denominator is 13 here and not 12.
`factors` is keyed by factor number, not ordered, because result
ORDER is not the contract this harness pins — the score, the
denominator and the per-factor verdicts are.
